description: Calibration anchors — solver-verified or playtest-verified spots that ANY trained model must predict correctly. Runs as Tier 0 before self-play. Catches distribution-shift regressions in seconds.

tolerance_rules.strict: Top-1 action must equal expected_action. Legal-action mask applied. No margin.
tolerance_rules.mixed: expected_action must appear in top-2 with probability >= 0.20. Used for known solver mixed-strategy spots.

anchors.rationale: TPGK on J-high turn, checked-to at compressed SPR ~1.25, worse_hand_pct 0.82, villain air_pct 0.22 + draw_pct 0.16. Solver: BET. This is the anchor v2.3.2 failed — the exact class Path C missed.

anchors.origin: v2.3.1 Layer 2 playtest finding — air on monotone, must CHECK (not BET on air)
anchors.rationale: AIR hero (Ad4d, no spade) on 3-spade flop, checked to at BTN. Historical v2.3 playtest bug: model predicted BET 98.6%. Layer 1 board_adjusted_hrp + Layer 2 air-CHECK counter-examples fixed this to CHECK 93%. Anchor protects the fix.

anchors.origin: v2.3.1 Layer 2 playtest finding — second air-on-paired playtest spot
anchors.rationale: AIR hero (Th5h, 10-high, no pair) on paired JJ2 board, BTN checked-to. Historical v2.3 bug: model predicted BET 72%. Layer 1 + Layer 2 fixed to CHECK 98%. Anchor protects the fix.

anchors.origin: v2.3.2 Path C value litmus — overpair on dry board, must BET for value
anchors.rationale: Hero AA (AhAs) on dry 7h5d2c, BTN checked-to. Overpair with eq >0.70, worse_hand_pct ~0.93, SPR ~1.1. Solver: clear value bet. Anchor protects strong-made-value class across Path C rescopes.

anchors.origin: v2.3.2 Path C value litmus — TPGK on two-tone board, must BET for value + protection
anchors.rationale: Hero KhQd (top pair good kicker) on KsTs3h two-tone spades, BTN checked-to. Eq ~0.62, worse_hand_pct ~0.85, draw-heavy board. Solver: BET small for value + protection. Anchor protects TPGK class — mirrors d2410's decision pattern at flop.
